create_instances_from_annotations: create an Instances object from a list of instance annotations with point coordinates and labels for point-supervised detection
subsample_point_annotations: subsample point coordinates and labels to a fixed number per instance using the sample_points parameter
transform_instance_annotations: apply geometric transforms to box and point annotations of a single instance and mark out-of-boundary points as unlabeled
review_annotations_to_instances: review the annotations_to_instances function to understand how point supervision data is converted into model-ready Instances objects
refactor_transform_instance_annotations: refactor the transform_instance_annotations function to support additional transform types beyond coordinate and box transformations
